messages:
sylvia-sales: Heads-up — presales POC with Northbridge Bank. They want EU + Canada only. Question: can we support tenant routing pinned to eu-west and canada-central with no cross-border egress? Also they ask for list of subprocessors for those regions and whether our control plane signals cross-region when on Dedicated.

alex-eng: Short answer: yes, but varies by deployment mode. Hosted API -> control plane metadata in control plane may be US. Dedicated -> option to pin model-serving and control-plane endpoints to customer region (Private is full control). Need to confirm subprocessors (cloud providers + infra partners).

mike-ops: @sylvia-sales what's their expected QPS and model size? affects whether Dedicated or Private recommended. If small QPS, Hosted with tenancy routing could work but not ideal for strict residency reqs.

sylvia-sales: They expect ~200 rps peak, mostly text-gen tokens (not embeddings). Security asked for BYOK too.

jordan-se: For BYOK + strict residency I'd push Private (VPC) or Dedicated with regional keystore. Dedicated supports customer-managed KMS in some regions — need ops confirm availability in canada-central.

alex-eng: Quick config example we can show them for Dedicated routing:```json
{
  "tenant_id": "northbridge",
  "region_preference": ["europe-west4","canada-central"],
  "failover_policy": "regional-only",
  "kms": {"type":"customer-managed","region":"canada-central"}
}
```This enforces routing policy at the gateway and rejects fallthrough to other regions. But fallback for capacity shortfall can be configured to notify and block instead of failover.

mike-ops: Subprocessors: in EU we use GCP europe-west4 + our on-prem partners; in Canada we use GCP canada-central (or Azure Canada East for certain customers). I will pull updated subprocessor attestation doc. Note: Hosted control plane may log non-sensitive metadata; if they require control plane in-region, recommend Private.

nina-legal: +1 on attestation doc. Also need to run their vendor questionnaire. Sylvia, can you drop the questionnaire PDF here? We need to map questions to subprocessors and dataflow diagram.

sylvia-sales: Dropped the PDF: https://northbridge-sec.notion/poc-vendor-scan (internal link) — they flagged: "Are any SMEs or support personnel outside EU/CA going to see customer content?" They want a statement.

alex-eng: Our standard statement: "Customer content processed in allocated region(s) and not accessible to support staff outside those regions, except for escalation with explicit customer consent." We can tighten language for Dedicated/Private.

mike-ops: Ops note: if they choose Hosted + strong routing, there is still an egress path for model updates and some telemetry. For strict legal requirements we should recommend Private/VPC. Costs: Dedicated ~1.8x hosted for reserved capacity, Private + BYOK onboarding is a one-time integration + higher infra ops.

jordan-se: I'll draft a short one-pager: options (Hosted with routing, Dedicated regional pin, Private VPC) + cost delta + security posture (subprocessors + KMS). ETA EOD tomorrow.

nina-legal: Also ask them to confirm retention / logging requirements. If they want long-term retention in-region only that's another constraint.

sylvia-sales: Noted. Their security person pinged: can we provide SSAE/ISO certs and subprocessor list for eu-west4 + canada-central?

mike-ops: We have ISO27001 and SOC2 reports; subprocessors list will include cloud providers and monitoring partners — I'll assemble a short CSV and a summary.

deploy-bot: [deployment-notice] Dedicated regional pinning requires a scheduled provisioning window. ETA ~3 business days after contract signed.

sylvia-sales: Great. Can we get a pricing delta ballpark for Dedicated -> Europe+Canada pin with 200 rps baseline? Need figure for presales.

alex-eng: Ballpark: Dedicated reserved pool sized for 200 rps text-gen = ~$35k/month committed. Private with BYOK and on-premish setup is a separate quote (one-time infra + monthly infra ops). I'll work with finance to firm numbers.

sylvia-sales: Thanks. I'll share draft one-pager with Northbridge and attach the questionnaire to legal. Please add subprocessors CSV when ready.

mike-ops: Will do. I'll ping once subprocessors doc and KMS availability for canada-central are validated.

jordan-se: Draft one-pager link: https://redwood-internal/sales/presales/northbridge-poc (will update).

sylvia-sales: Awesome team :thumbsup: — marking this thread for follow-up tomorrow.
